name: fix-campaign-traps
about: bugs 10.22.26 line 29 and the HoH1 teleporters: with campaign.trap_map 2 (Dark Citadel, issue #30), a generated indoor Dark Citadel floor (index 2, cave_dark_1; another floor on a retry) places the hwp_traps set (`traps: placed N/M`, N > 0), the trap units are in the scene, standing on a spike floor (or a bomb glyph's blast) costs health, and the teleporter pad the generator placed (or a cheat pad) moves the player to its logged destination on use, the same spot on a second use. A screenshot of the floor at the end. About 4 minutes.

steps.name: a generated indoor floor placed at least one HoH1 trap

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] teleporter (placed at -?\d+,-?\d+ \(cell \d+,\d+\) -> -?\d+,-?\d+ \(cell \d+,\d+, [^)]*\)|at cell \d+,\d+: no destination, the pad picks one at use|: no spot on this floor)
steps.name: the generator reported the teleporter pad (placed with a destination, or why not)
trap units present and damaging; the teleporter jumps to its fixed destination twice
